title: Grateful Dead Live at Richfield Coliseum on 1993-09-09
lineage: DAT(m) > Tascam DA-20mkII > SPDIF > Tascam HD-P2 > r8brain (16/48 > 16/44) > CDWave > FLAC; DAT(m) sourced by Alan Schmit; Transfer by Terry Watts
source: Source:  (stand/ORTF/110^/DFC/Section) B&K 4011s > Neumann BS48i-2 > Panasonic SV-255 > DAT(m);

ai_review.summary: A solid audience tape that captures a strong second set often hailed as one of the best ’90s Dew performances.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise this recording for its energetic second set, calling it possibly the finest Dew-era show of the 1990s. The audience source is described as “not a bad aud,” indicating decent clarity for a crowd tape. Overall the performance and listening experience are highly regarded.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is rated very high (strong second set, “stellar” Dew), while the audience recording is considered decent but not exceptional; combined weighted score yields ~4.3.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note the tape is an audience ("aud") recording and describe it as “not a bad” – clear enough for enjoyment but without claims of superb fidelity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set highlighted as the peak of the concert, with reviewers calling it one of the best Dew-era shows of the ’90s.
